name: app-oviah-affinity-mapping-clusters-six-theme-cards
title: OVIAH affinity mapping: six themed lilac clusters grouping research findings into insight statements
whatItIs: A 3x2 grid of alternating light and mid-lilac cards titled 'Affinity Mapping (Clusters)': Physical Challenges, Emotional Challenges, Tracking Issues, Information Gap, Medical Record Management and a second Tracking Issues cluster, each listing bullet findings and closing with an italic synthesised insight quote.
whatItMeans: Synthesised and traceable; grouping raw findings into named clusters shows how research became design direction.
techniques: Cluster raw findings under named themes.
Close each cluster with a synthesised first-person insight.
Alternate card tints to distinguish adjacent clusters.

vocabulary.definition: Grouping research data into themes based on natural relationships.
A summarising insight drawn from grouped data.
